# src.store.ParticipantRow
# kaynak: src/store/entities.py
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ParticipantRow:
    id: int
    sport: Optional[str]
    name: Optional[str]
    short_name: Optional[str]
    slug: Optional[str]
    name_code: Optional[str]
    country: Optional[str]
    gender: Optional[str]
    type: Optional[int]
    national: Optional[bool]
    updated_at: int
